topic: Caches outside internal/rag that hold content are not keyed by space (INV-11)
detail: SP-024 keys every cache in internal/rag by space or collection (the unchanged-write check, store objects and their layouts, the collection list). Elsewhere: orchd's PR detail cache (internal/daemon/reviews.go detailCache) holds PR titles and bodies keyed by URL only, served to whoever may call GetPRDetail; the docs sync's per-file hash cache (docs_files) decides whether a doc is written again and is keyed by URI (RC-124 covers its placement). Decide whether INV-11 requires keying these by space too, or whether SP-025's read enforcement (the caller's readable spaces) is the rule for them.
note: SP-026 (#200) checks the caller's spaces before GetPRDetail reads or fills the URL-keyed detail cache, so read enforcement already keeps it within spaces; recommended: settle RC-351 as 'read enforcement is the rule for caches outside internal/rag'.
